quiz.why: 건강 means health. 건강을 유지하기 위해 꾸준히 유산소 운동을 해요. (To maintain health, I consistently do aerobic exercise.)
병 means disease. 감기라는 병에 걸렸어요. (I caught an illness called a cold.)
동물병원 means animal hospital; veterinary clinic. 집 근처 동물병원에서 주사를 맞혀요. (I get vaccine shots at the vet clinic near my house.)
몸 means body. 환절기에는 따뜻한 물을 자주 마셔서 몸을 보호해요. (In seasonal transitions, I protect my body by drinking warm water often.)
배 means stomach; belly. 점심을 많이 먹어서 저녁때까지 배가 전혀 안 고파요. (I ate a lot for lunch, so I'm not hungry at all until dinner.)
팔 means arm. 행운의 숫자 팔을 아주 좋아해요. (I really like the lucky number eight.)

fill.en: I get vaccine shots at the vet clinic near my house.

fill.q: 날씨가 더워서 미용실에 가서 ___를 짧게 잘랐어요.
fill.en: Because the weather is hot, I went to the salon and cut my hair short.
I cross the Han River bridge to go to school.

cards.en: to be painful; to be sick (adjective)
to be big; to be large (adjective)
to be fast; to be quick (adjective)

quiz.why: 코 means nose. 높은 코가 아주 매력적이에요. (The high bridge of the nose is very attractive.)
피곤하다 means tired; exhausted; fatigued. 피곤할 때는 일찍 잠자리에 들어요. (When tired, I go to bed early.)
되다 means to become. 열심히 공부해서 훌륭한 선생님이 돼요. (I study hard to become a great teacher.)
나다 means happen; break out; come out. 길에서 갑자기 큰 소리가 났어요. (A loud noise suddenly occurred on the street.)
끝나다 means to end; to finish. 시험이 끝나면 친구들과 신나게 놀 거예요. (When the exam ends, I will have fun with friends.)
빨리 means quickly; fast. 수업 시간에 늦지 않으려고 학교로 빨리 걸어갔어요. (In order not to be late for class, I walked quickly to school.)

fill.en: to be painful; to be sick

cards.en: to be many; to be much (adjective)
do a right thing; do right (verb)

quiz.why: 다른 means different; other. 이것 말고 다른 책을 읽어요. (I read another book besides this one.)
잘 means well. 연습을 많이 해서 한국어를 잘해요. (Because I practice a lot, I speak Korean well.)
더 means more. 날씨가 점점 더 따뜻해지고 있어요. (The weather is getting increasingly warmer.)
자주 means often. 고향에 계신 부모님께 전화를 자주 드려요. (I often call my parents in my hometown.)
다시 means again. 틀린 문제를 복습하기 위해 단어를 다시 외워요. (To review wrong problems, I memorize the words again.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "head of a household"?
quiz.why: 가장 means head of a household. 사계절 중에서 알록달록한 가을이 저는 가장 좋아요. (Among the four seasons, I like colorful autumn the best.)

fill.en: I often call my parents in my hometown.
The weather is so good today that I go on an outing.

fill.q: 틀린 문제를 복습하기 위해 단어를 ___ 외워요.
fill.en: To review wrong problems, I memorize the words again.

cards.en: to be few; to be little (verb)
to be special; to be extraordinary (adjective)

quiz.why: 무겁다 means to be heavy. 이 상자는 너무 무겁습니다. (This box is too heavy.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be high"?
quiz.why: 높다 means to be high. 서울에는 높은 건물이 많아요. (There are many tall buildings in Seoul.)
제일 means most; best; number one. 반에서 키가 제일 커요. (He is the tallest in the class.)
두 means two. 사과 두 개를 깨끗이 씻어서 먹어요. (I wash two apples cleanly and eat them.)
만 means ten thousand; only. 이 신발의 가격은 오만 원이에요. (The price of these shoes is fifty thousand won.)
가지 means branch; sprig; bough; twig. 시장에는 여러 가지 신선한 과일들이 진열되어 있어요. (Various kinds of fresh fruits are displayed at the market.)

fill.q: 가방 속에 넣을 책 한 권과 공책 ___를 골라요.
fill.en: I pick one book and one notebook to put in my bag.

quiz.why: 삼 means ginseng. 한국에서 생활한 지 올해로 벌써 삼 년이 되었어요. (It has already been three years this year since I lived in Korea.)
일곱 means seven. 바구니 속에 신선하고 빨간 사과가 일곱 개 들어 있어요. (There are seven fresh and red apples inside the basket.)
삼십 means thirty; 30. 책의 가격은 삼십 달러예요. (The price of the book is thirty dollars.)
아홉 means nine; 9. 사과가 바구니에 아홉 개 있어요. (There are nine apples in the basket.)
이십 means twenty. 이 책은 이십 달러예요. (This book is twenty dollars.)
서른 means thirty. 서른 살이 되면 독립하고 싶어요. (I want to be independent when I turn thirty.)

fill.en: I write down new words in my notebook one by one.

quiz.why: 마흔 means forty; 40. 마흔 명의 관객이 모였어요. (Forty audience members gathered.)
번호 means number. 은행에서 대기 번호표를 뽑았어요. (I pulled a waiting number ticket at the bank.)
스물 means twenty; 20. 스물부터 서른까지 숫자를 세어요. (I count numbers from twenty to thirty.)
억 means ah; argh; eek. 복권에 당첨되어 십억을 받았어요. (I won the lottery and received one billion won.)
영 means not in the least. 축구 경기 점수가 이 대 영이에요. (The soccer match score is two to zero.)
일흔 means seventy; 70. 마을에 일흔 가구가 살고 있어요. (Seventy households live in the village.)

fill.en: I pulled a waiting number ticket at the bank.

cards.en: to be close; to be near (adjective)

quiz.why: 밖 means outside. 날씨가 좋아서 집 밖으로 산책을 나가요. (The weather is good, so I go outside the house for a walk.)
뒤 means back; behind; after. 건물 뒤에 작은 정원이 있어서 산책하기 좋아요. (There is a small garden behind the building, so it is nice to walk.)
근처 means nearby; vicinity. 집 근처에 있는 편의점에 가서 따뜻한 음료를 사요. (I go to a convenience store near my house and buy a warm drink.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be far"?
quiz.why: 멀다 means to be far. 역에서 집이 멀지 않아요. (The house is not far from the station.)
어디에서나 means anywhere; everywhere. 한국 노래는 어디에서나 들려요. (Korean songs are heard everywhere.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "give a gift"?
quiz.why: 선물하다 means give a gift. 어머니께 꽃다발을 선물하고 싶어요. (I want to gift a flower bouquet to my mother.)

fill.en: The person standing in the middle of the photo is me.
I arrange books neatly by type on the shelf.
I watch traditional instrument performances at the cultural center.

quiz.why: 입다 means to wear; to put on. 날씨가 쌀쌀하니까 따뜻한 외투를 입어요. (Because the weather is chilly, I wear a warm coat.)
가방 means bag. 학교에 갈 때 교과서와 필통을 가방에 넣어요. (When going to school, I put textbooks and pencil cases in my bag.)
실내화 means indoor shoes; slippers. 하얀 실내화를 깨끗이 빨았어요. (I washed the white slippers cleanly.)
등산화 means hiking boots. 새로 산 등산화 끈을 단단히 매요. (I firmly tie the laces of my newly bought hiking boots.)
치마 means skirt. 백화점에서 긴 치마를 샀어요. (I bought a long skirt at the department store.)
얼마 means how much; some amount. 이 사과 한 상자에 얼마인지 여쭤봐요. (I ask how much this box of apples is.)

fill.en: I bought a pair of jeans at the department store.
I wore pretty Hanbok at Gyeongbokgung Palace.
I firmly tie the laces of my newly bought hiking boots.

cards.en: to be careful; to watch out (verb)

quiz.why: 앉다 means to sit. 다리가 아파서 빈 의자에 잠깐 앉아요. (Because my legs hurt, I sit on an empty chair for a moment.)
쉬다 means rest; take a break. 주말에는 집에서 음악을 들으며 푹 쉬어요. (On weekends, I rest soundly at home listening to music.)
자다 means to sleep. 피곤해서 어제는 저녁 일찍 푹 잤어요. (Because I was tired, I slept soundly early in the evening yesterday.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to put in"?
quiz.why: 넣다 means to put in; to insert. 외출하기 전에 필요한 소지품을 가방에 넣어요. (Before going out, I put necessary belongings into my bag.)
씻다 means to wash; to clean. 밥을 먹기 전에 비누로 손을 깨끗하게 씻어요. (Before eating, I wash my hands cleanly with soap.)
준비하다 means to prepare. 내일 발표를 위해 수업 자료를 꼼꼼히 준비해요. (I prepare class materials meticulously for tomorrow's presentation.)

fill.en: I eat an apple every morning for my health.

fill.q: 친구들과 함께 모여 즐거운 ___ 파티를 열어요.
fill.en: We gather with friends and throw an enjoyable birthday party.

cards.en: to be decided; to be set (verb)

quiz.why: 다녀오다 means go and come back. 오전 아홉 시에 학교에 다녀와서 집에서 점심을 먹어요. (I go to school at 9 a.m. and return home to eat lunch.)
돌아오다 means to return; to come back. 수업이 모두 끝나고 오후 늦게 기숙사로 돌아와요. (All classes end and I return to the dorm late in the afternoon.)
우체국 means post office. 편지를 부치러 우체국에 가요. (I go to the post office to mail a letter.)
미용실 means hair salon; beauty parlor. 동네 미용실 원장님이 친절해요. (The neighborhood hair salon owner is kind.)
배달하다 means to deliver. 신문을 아침마다 집 앞에 배달해요. (They deliver newspapers in front of houses every morning.)
이것 means this; this thing. 이것은 제가 좋아하는 책이에요. (This is a book that I like.)

fill.en: I don't have plans for the weekend yet.
They don't sell cigarettes inside the building.
I enter the warm tub at the public bathhouse to warm up.

quiz.why: 불편해지다 means to become inconvenient. 비가 와서 교통이 불편해졌어요. (Traffic became inconvenient because of rain.)
주로 means usually. 친구들과 한국어로 주로 말해요. (I mostly speak in Korean with friends.)
사용 means use; usage. 컴퓨터를 오래 사용하면 눈이 아파요. (If you use a computer for long, your eyes hurt.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "washing one's face"?
quiz.why: 세수 means washing one's face. 찬물로 세수하고 정신을 차려요. (I wash my face with cold water and wake up.)
찾아보다 means look for; search; visit. 서랍에서 열쇠를 찾아보세요. (Please look for the key in the drawer.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be free"?
quiz.why: 한가하다 means to be free; not busy. 한가한 오후에 공원을 산책해요. (I take a walk in the park on a leisurely afternoon.)

fill.en: If you use a computer for long, your eyes hurt.
I try to lead a regular daily life.
After the exercise finished, I took a shower.

quiz.why: 가게 means shop; store. 집 앞 작은 과일 가게에서 달콤한 딸기를 샀어요. (I bought sweet strawberries at the small fruit shop in front of my house.)
물건 means thing; item; goods. 필요한 물건을 사기 위해 마트에 들렀어요. (I stopped by the supermarket to buy needed items.)
팔다 means to sell. 주말 벼룩시장에서 안 쓰는 헌 책과 물건을 팔아요. (At the weekend flea market, I sell used books and unused items.)
고르다 means to choose; to select. 친구의 생일 축하 파티에 줄 예쁜 선물을 골라요. (I choose a pretty gift to give at my friend's birthday celebration party.)
영업시간 means business hours. 문 앞에 영업시간 안내가 붙었어요. (A notice of business hours is posted on the door.)
백화점 means department store. 주말이라 백화점에 사람이 많아요. (There are many people at the department store on weekends.)

fill.q: 이 옷은 디자인도 예쁘고 ___도 아주 착해요.
fill.en: This clothing has a pretty design and the price is also very good.
I eat delicious food at the traditional market.
I bought books cheaply with a discount coupon.

quiz.why: 때 means time; moment. 방학 때 친구들과 바다로 여행을 가요. (During vacation, I go on a trip to the sea with friends.)
시 means o'clock; hour. 오후 두 시에 친구와 만나기로 했어요. (I agreed to meet my friend at 2 o'clock in the afternoon.)
주말 means weekend. 이번 주말에는 집에서 푹 쉬고 싶어요. (This weekend, I want to rest soundly at home.)
전 means before; ago. 식사 전에는 손을 항상 깨끗하게 씻어요. (Before meals, I always wash my hands cleanly.)
날 means day. 비가 오는 날에는 따뜻한 국물이 생각나요. (On rainy days, I think of warm soup.)
요즘 means these days; lately. 요즘 날씨가 따뜻해서 나들이 가기 좋아요. (These days the weather is warm, so it is nice to go on an outing.)

fill.en: This weekend, I want to rest soundly at home.
I take a walk while breathing the fresh morning air.
Next weekend, I go on a trip to Jeju Island with friends.

quiz.why: 걸리다 means to catch (cold); to take time. 환절기에는 감기에 걸리지 않게 조심하세요. (Please be careful not to catch a cold during the change of seasons.)
먼저 means first; beforehand. 식사하기 전에 손을 먼저 깨끗이 씻어요. (Before having a meal, I wash my hands cleanly first.)
월 means month; being monthly. 봄이 시작되는 삼 월에는 따뜻한 바람이 불어요. (In March, when spring begins, a warm breeze blows.)
일요일 means Sunday. 일요일에는 가족과 함께 편안하게 휴식을 취해요. (On Sundays, I rest comfortably with my family.)
나중 means later; after. 지금은 바쁘니까 자세한 이야기는 나중에 나눠요. (Because I am busy now, let's share detailed stories later.)
오전 means morning (a.m.). 오전에 도서관에서 공부하고 오후에 운동해요. (I study at the library in the morning and exercise in the afternoon.)

fill.q: 방학 ___ 한국의 유명한 관광지를 여행할 거예요.
fill.en: During vacation, I will travel to famous tourist attractions in Korea.
On Sundays, I rest comfortably with my family.

fill.q: ___ 일곱 시에 온 가족이 둘러앉아 식사해요.
fill.en: At 7 in the evening, the whole family sits around and eats.

quiz.why: 날짜 means date. 친구들과 함께 모임 날짜를 달력에 표시해 둬요. (We mark the meeting date on the calendar together with friends.)
년 means year(s). 한국어를 배운 지 올해로 벌써 일 년이 다 되었어요. (It has already been nearly one year since I learned Korean.)
목요일 means Thursday. 이번 주 목요일에 시험이 있어요. (There is an exam this Thursday.)
지난달 means last month. 지난달 시험 결과를 확인했어요. (I checked the exam results from last month.)
밤늦게 means late at night. 밤늦게 전화하면 실례예요. (It is rude to call late at night.)
며칠 means date. 오늘이 몇 월 며칠이에요? (What is the date today?)

fill.q: 손님이 오셔서 이야기를 나누러 밖에서 ___ 기다려요.
fill.en: Guests arrived, so I wait outside for a moment to talk.
There is an exam this Thursday.
I came to Korea this spring.

quiz.why: 오래전 means long ago; long time ago. 그 일은 아주 오래전 이야기예요. (That matter is a story from a very long time ago.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "after a long time"?
quiz.why: 오랜만에 means after a long time. 주말에 오랜만에 푹 쉬었어요. (I took a good rest after a long time on the weekend.)
내년 means next year. 내년 여름휴가는 바다로 가고 싶어요. (I want to go to the sea for next year's summer vacation.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "day after tomorrow"?
quiz.why: 모레 means day after tomorrow. 모레 한국어 시험을 봐요. (I take the Korean exam the day after tomorrow.)
십이월 means December. 십이월 말에 한 해를 마무리해요. (We wrap up the year at the end of December.)
이따가 means later; in a little while. 이따가 도서관 앞에서 만나요. (Let's meet in front of the library in a little while.)

fill.en: On which day of the week is the Korean class?
I want to go to the sea for next year's summer vacation.

cards.en: to be cool; to be refreshing (adjective)

quiz.why: 지나다 means pass; elapse. 약국을 지나서 오른쪽으로 가세요. (Pass the pharmacy and go right.)
팔월 means August. 팔월 십오일은 한국의 광복절이에요. (August 15th is Korea's National Liberation Day.)
따뜻하다 means to be warm. 추운 겨울에는 따뜻한 차가 최고예요. (Warm tea is the best in cold winter.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be hot (weather)"?
quiz.why: 덥다 means to be hot (weather). 여름에는 날씨가 무척 덥고 습해요. (In summer, the weather is very hot and humid.)
계절 means season. 봄에서 여름으로 계절이 바뀌며 날씨가 점점 더워져요. (As the season changes from spring to summer, the weather gets warmer.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be cool"?
quiz.why: 시원하다 means to be cool; to be refreshing. 시원한 물을 한 잔 마셔요. (I drink a glass of cool water.)

fill.en: Because it rains, please take an umbrella when going out.
A cool breeze blows gently outside, so it is refreshing.

fill.q: 추운 ___에는 따뜻한 목도리를 두르고 장갑을 껴요.
fill.en: In the cold winter, I wrap a warm scarf and wear gloves.

cards.en: to be clear; to be clean (adjective)
to make up one's mind; to resolve (verb)
to be good; to be nice (adjective)
to be hard; to be difficult (adjective)
to be okay; to be all right (adjective)
to be glad; to be pleased (adjective)

quiz.why: 맑다 means to be clear; to be clean. 시골의 공기가 아주 맑고 좋아요. (The countryside air is very clear and nice.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be important"?
quiz.why: 중요하다 means to be important. 이 약속은 아주 중요해요. (This appointment is very important.)
나쁘다 means to be bad. 건강에 나쁜 습관을 고쳐요. (I fix habits that are bad for health.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be good"?
quiz.why: 좋다 means to be good; to be nice. 이 식당은 음식 맛과 품질이 좋아요. (This restaurant has good food taste and quality.)
마음 means mind; heart. 친구의 따뜻한 위로에 마음이 편안해졌어요. (My heart felt at ease with my friend's warm comfort.)
기분 means mood; feeling. 시험에 합격했다는 소식을 듣고 기분이 무척 좋았어요. (Hearing the news of passing the exam, I felt very happy.)

fill.en: to be clear; to be clean

cards.en: to be sad; to be sorrowful (adjective)
to want to; to come to desire (verb)
to be nervous; to be tense (verb)
disgusting; distasteful; having no taste for (adjective)

quiz.why: 슬프다 means to be sad; to be sorrowful. 슬픈 영화를 보고 나서 눈물이 주르륵 흘렀어요. (After watching a sad movie, tears streamed down.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to want to"?
quiz.why: 싶어지다 means to want to; to come to desire. 노래를 들으니 춤추고 싶어져요. (Listening to the song, I want to dance.)
기쁘다 means happy; glad. 시험에 합격해서 정말 기쁩니다. (I am truly happy because I passed the test.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to become comfortable"?
quiz.why: 편안해지다 means to become comfortable. 집에 돌아오니 몸이 편안해졌어요. (My body felt comfortable after coming home.)
미안 means being sorry. 기다리게 해서 정말 미안해요. (I am really sorry to have kept you waiting.)
재미없다 means not interesting; boring. 재미없는 책을 읽다가 졸았어요. (I dozed off while reading an uninteresting book.)

fill.en: to be sad; to be sorrowful
to want to; to come to desire

quiz.why: 밥하다 means cook rice. 전기밥솥으로 밥하고 국을 끓여요. (I cook rice with the electric rice cooker and boil soup.)
밥 means meal; cooked rice. 점심시간에 친구와 따뜻한 밥을 먹어요. (I eat a warm meal with a friend at lunchtime.)
김밥 means gimbap; seaweed rice roll. 소풍 갈 때 먹으려고 아침에 참치 김밥을 맛있게 싸요. (In the morning, I make delicious tuna gimbap to eat on a picnic.)
불고기 means bulgogi. 식당에서 불고기 2인분을 시켰어요. (I ordered 2 servings of bulgogi at the restaurant.)
수박 means watermelon. 시장에서 큰 수박 한 통을 샀어요. (I bought a large whole watermelon at the market.)
감 means persimmon. 나무에 주황색 감이 열렸어요. (Orange persimmons grew on the tree.)

fill.en: I ordered 2 servings of bulgogi at the restaurant.
I bought a sweet chocolate cake.
I ate kimchi stew at the restaurant for lunch.

quiz.why: 떡볶이 means tteokbokki; spicy rice cakes. 떡볶이 일 인분을 포장해 왔어요. (I got one portion of tteokbokki for takeout.)
오렌지 means orange. 아침 식사 때 오렌지 주스를 마셔요. (I drink orange juice at breakfast.)
초콜릿 means chocolate. 피곤할 때 초콜릿을 하나 먹어요. (I eat a piece of chocolate when I am tired.)
커피 means coffee. 점심을 먹고 시원한 아이스 커피를 마셔요. (After eating lunch, I drink a cool iced coffee.)
우유 means milk. 아침마다 빵과 함께 신선하고 고소한 우유를 마셔요. (Every morning, I drink fresh and nutty milk along with bread.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "lemon-lime soda (clear, fizzy)"?
quiz.why: 사이다 means lemon-lime soda (clear, fizzy). 식당에서 사이다 한 병을 시켰어요. (I ordered a bottle of soda at the restaurant.)

fill.en: I make japchae with vegetables and glass noodles.
I eat a piece of chocolate when I am tired.
I bought a box of fresh grapes at the market.

cards.en: to be delicious; to be tasty (adjective)
to be spicy; to be hot (adjective)

quiz.why: 콜라 means cola; coke. 시원한 콜라 한 캔을 샀어요. (I bought a cold can of cola.)
고기 means meat. 저녁에 불고기를 맛있게 구워 먹어요. (I grill and eat bulgogi deliciously for dinner.)
소금 means salt. 소금이 많이 들어가서 짜요. (It is salty because a lot of salt went in.)
포장하다 means wrap; gift-wrap; pack. 남은 음식을 포장해 달라고 했어요. (I asked them to pack the leftover food.)
인분 means serving; portion. 불고기 일 인분 더 주세요. (Please give us one more serving of bulgogi.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be spicy"?
quiz.why: 맵다 means to be spicy; to be hot. 이 떡볶이는 고추가 많이 들어가서 매워요. (This tteokbokki is spicy because it contains a lot of chili.)

fill.en: I bought yellow bananas at the market.
I bought sweet Korean melons at the summer market.
It is salty because a lot of salt went in.

cards.en: to not exist; to not have (adjective)
to prevent from; to be unable to (verb)
to be necessary; to be needed (adjective)

quiz.why: 싱겁다 means bland; not salty enough. 간을 안 해서 음식이 싱거워요. (The food is bland because it wasn't seasoned.)
가다 means to go. 주말에 가족과 함께 공원에 가요. (I go to the park with my family on the weekend.)
보다 means to see; to look. 창밖을 보면서 따뜻한 차를 마셔요. (I look out the window while drinking warm tea.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to not exist"?
quiz.why: 없다 means to not exist; to not have. 지금은 시간이 없어서 나중에 통화해요. (I have no time now, so let's talk later.)
계시다 means to be; to stay (honorific). 부모님께서는 지금 고향 집에 계세요. (My parents are currently at home in my hometown.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be necessary"?
quiz.why: 필요하다 means to be necessary; to be needed. 한국어 시험 준비를 위해 기출문제 책이 필요해요. (I need a past exam book to prepare for the Korean test.)

cards.en: you (to a friend or someone younger) (pronoun)

quiz.why: 때문 means because of. 교통 체증 때문에 약속 장소에 십 분 늦었어요. (Because of the traffic jam, I was ten minutes late to the meeting place.)
그러면 means if so. 비가 와요? 그러면 우산을 챙기세요. (Is it raining? Then take an umbrella.)
저 means I; me (humble). 저는 한국어를 배우는 학생입니다. (I am a student learning Korean.)
그 means that; the; he. 그 식당의 음식은 정말 맛이 좋아요. (The food at that restaurant is really good in taste.)

opts: you (to a friend or someone younger)
quiz.why: 거기 means there; that place. 식당 위치가 거기에 있어요. (The restaurant location is over there.)
그쪽 means that way; there; you. 그쪽 날씨는 요즘 어때요? (How is the weather over there these days?)

fill.en: It rains. However, I go to exercise.
The weather is cold. However, it is clear.
If you do it this way, it is very easy.

quiz.why: 뭐 means what. 오늘 점심 메뉴로 뭐 먹을래요? (What do you want to eat for lunch today?)
어느 means which; some. 두 옷 중에서 어느 옷이 더 마음에 들어요? (Between the two clothes, which one do you like more?)
어떻다 means such. 오늘 날씨가 어떤지 창밖을 내다봐요. (I look out the window to see how the weather is today.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be clean"?
quiz.why: 깨끗하다 means to be clean. 방을 깨끗하게 청소하니 기분이 상쾌해요. (Cleaning the room cleanly makes me feel refreshed.)
청소 means cleaning. 주말 아침에 온 가족이 모여 집 안 대청소를 해요. (On weekend mornings, the whole family gathers and does a big house cleaning.)
빗자루 means broom. 마당 구석에 큰 빗자루를 두었어요. (I placed a big broom in the corner of the yard.)

cards.en: to be wide; to be broad (adjective)

quiz.why: 침대 means bed. 피곤한 하루를 마치고 푹신한 침대에 편안히 누워요. (Finishing a tiring day, I lie down comfortably on the soft bed.)
가구 means household; furniture. 가구점에서 침대와 책상을 골라요. (I choose a bed and a desk at the furniture store.)
기숙사 means dormitory. 학교 안에 있는 편리한 기숙사에서 친구와 살아요. (I live with a friend in a convenient dormitory inside the school.)
아파트 means apartment. 아파트 놀이터에서 아이들이 놀아요. (Children play at the apartment playground.)
열쇠 means key. 가방 안에 집 열쇠를 넣어 두었어요. (I kept the house key in my bag.)
차고 means garage. 차고 문을 닫고 열쇠를 잠갔어요. (I closed the garage door and locked the key.)

fill.en: I pull the chair up in front of the desk and sit.

fill.q: 학교 안에 있는 편리한 ___에서 친구와 살아요.
fill.en: I live with a friend in a convenient dormitory inside the school.
Children play at the apartment playground.

quiz.why: 문 means door; gate. 방이 추워서 문을 닫았어요. (The room was cold, so I closed the door.)
화장실 means toilet; restroom; bathroom. 지하철역 안에 있는 깨끗한 화장실을 이용해요. (I use the clean restroom inside the subway station.)
부엌 means kitchen. 부엌 싱크대를 깨끗하게 청소해요. (I clean the kitchen sink cleanly.)
노래하다 means sing. 기분이 좋아서 크게 노래했어요. (I felt good, so I sang out loud.)
춤 means dance; dancing. 한국 전통 춤을 배우고 싶어요. (I want to learn traditional Korean dance.)
피아노 means piano. 거실 한쪽에 작은 피아노가 있어요. (There is a small piano on one side of the living room.)

fill.en: I enjoy my hobby over the weekend.
I invite people to the year-end party.
There is a small piano on one side of the living room.

quiz.why: 음악 means music. 카페에서 흘러나오는 잔잔한 음악을 들어요. (I listen to gentle music playing from the cafe.)
부르다 means to call; to sing. 저 멀리서 걸어오는 반가운 친구의 이름을 불러요. (I call the name of my welcome friend walking from afar.)
영화관 means movie theater. 집 근처에 새로 생긴 영화관이 있어요. (There is a newly opened cinema near my house.)
노래방 means karaoke room; noraebang. 노래방에 가서 스트레스를 풀어요. (I go to the karaoke room to relieve stress.)
콘서트 means concert. 콘서트 티켓을 예매했어요. (I reserved a concert ticket.)
운동 means exercise; sport. 건강한 생활을 위해 매일 가벼운 운동을 해요. (For a healthy life, I do light exercise every day.)

fill.en: I enjoy fun games on my smartphone.
After dinner, I watch popular dramas.
I go to the karaoke room to relieve stress.

cards.en: hit; strike; play (an instrument); rain; snow; blow (verb)

quiz.why: 수영장 means swimming pool. 주말 아침마다 건강을 위해 동네 수영장에 다녀요. (Every weekend morning, I attend the local swimming pool for my health.)
물놀이 means water play; swimming. 아이들이 수영장에서 물놀이를 즐겨요. (Children enjoy playing in the water at the pool.)
걷기 means walking. 건강을 위해 걷기 습관을 길러요. (I build a walking habit for my health.)
준비운동 means warm-up. 준비운동으로 몸의 긴장을 풀어요. (I release body tension with warm-up exercise.)
농구 means basketball. 텔레비전으로 농구 경기를 봤어요. (I watched a basketball game on TV.)
치다 means hit; strike; play (an instrument); rain; snow; blow. 어릴 때부터 피아노를 쳤어요. (I have played the piano since childhood.)

fill.en: The child rides the slide excitedly.
I build a walking habit for my health.
I stretch my legs and do kicks in the swimming pool.

cards.en: Mr./Ms. (polite title used after a name) (noun)

quiz.why: 마리 means counter for animals. 마당에서 작은 새 두 마리가 정답게 지저귀어요. (Two small birds chirp pleasantly in the yard.)
동물보호센터 means animal shelter; animal protection center. 주말에 동물보호센터에서 봉사해요. (I volunteer at the animal shelter on the weekend.)
바다 means sea; ocean. 푸른 바다를 보며 힐링해요. (I heal while looking at the blue sea.)
피우다 means make bloom; open up. 담배를 피우지 마세요. (Please do not smoke.)
나무 means tree; wood. 공원 나무 아래에서 쉬어요. (I rest under the tree in the park.)
만나다 means to meet. 카페에서 친구와 만나서 이야기를 나눠요. (I meet a friend at a cafe and share stories.)

fill.en: I heal while looking at the blue sea.
I caught a grasshopper in the grassy field.
I rest under the tree in the park.

cards.en: to be kind; to be friendly (adjective)

quiz.why: 혼자 means alone; by oneself. 조용히 생각을 정리하며 혼자 영화를 봤어요. (I watched a movie alone, quietly organizing my thoughts.)
함께 means together. 가족들과 함께 저녁 식사를 하며 이야기를 나눠요. (I share stories having dinner together with my family.)
외국인 means foreigner; foreign national. 교실에 외국인 친구가 많아요. (There are many foreign friends in the classroom.)
국적 means nationality; citizenship. 그분의 국적은 한국이에요. (His nationality is Korean.)
여자 means woman; female. 많은 여자 손님들이 가게에 왔어요. (Many female customers came to the shop.)
할머니 means grandmother; elderly woman. 방학마다 시골에 계신 할머니를 찾아봬요. (Every vacation, I visit my grandmother in the countryside.)

fill.en: The restaurant auntie is very kind.
The uncle next door is very kind.

quiz.why: 아이 means child. 놀이터에서 어린아이들이 밝게 웃으며 뛰어놀아요. (Young children laugh brightly and run around on the playground.)
아버지 means father. 퇴근하고 오신 아버지께 공손하게 인사를 드려요. (I greet father politely when he returns home from work.)
남동생 means younger brother. 남동생에게 선물을 주었어요. (I gave a present to my younger brother.)
딸 means daughter. 딸의 생일에 예쁜 인형을 주었어요. (I gave a pretty doll for my daughter's birthday.)
언니 means older sister (for females). 언니와 함께 카페에서 이야기해요. (I chat with my older sister at a cafe.)
사장님 means president. 식당 사장님께서 친절하게 따뜻한 반찬을 더 주셨어요. (The restaurant owner kindly gave more warm side dishes.)

fill.en: I gave a present to my younger brother.
My husband is really good at cooking.
My older sister bought me delicious bread.

cards.en: to be pretty; to be beautiful (adjective)

quiz.why: 영화배우 means movie actor / actress. 극장에서 유명한 영화배우를 보았어요. (I saw a famous film actor at the theater.)
직원 means employee; staff. 회사 직원들과 회식을 해요. (I have a company dinner with office colleagues.)
예쁘다 means to be pretty; to be beautiful. 봄이 되니 길가에 예쁜 꽃들이 피었어요. (As spring arrives, pretty flowers bloom on the roadside.)
학생 means student. 교실에서 학생들이 한국어 수업을 들어요. (Students take a Korean class in the classroom.)
교실 means classroom. 아침에 교실에 들어가서 창문을 열고 환기해요. (I enter the classroom in the morning, open the window, and air it out.)
운동장 means playground; sports field. 학생들이 운동장에서 축구해요. (Students play soccer on the playground.)

fill.en: Many office workers take the subway every morning.
I politely ask the teacher about words I don't know.
Students take a Korean class in the classroom.

quiz.why: 쓰다 means to write; to use. 공책에 한국어 단어를 바르게 써요. (I write Korean words correctly in my notebook.)
도서관 means library. 조용한 도서관에서 시험 공부에 집중해요. (I focus on exam studying in the quiet library.)
공부 means study. 도서관에서 한국어 시험 공부를 열심히 해요. (I study hard for the Korean exam at the library.)
시험 means exam; test. 내일 있을 한국어 말하기 시험을 열심히 준비해요. (I diligently prepare for tomorrow's Korean speaking test.)
연습 means practice; training. 방과 후에 피아노 연습을 해요. (I practice piano after school.)
우리말 means Korean language; our language. 우리말 노래를 즐겨 들어요. (I enjoy listening to Korean songs.)

fill.en: I write class contents in my notebook.
I memorize Korean words every day.

quiz.why: 집중하다 means concentrate. 선생님 말씀에 집중하세요. (Please concentrate on what the teacher says.)
편지지 means letter paper. 편지지에 정성껏 글을 적어요. (I write words carefully on the letter paper.)
합격하다 means pass; get through. 한국어 시험에 꼭 합격하고 싶어요. (I really want to pass the Korean test.)
수첩 means pocket notebook. 가방에서 작은 수첩을 꺼냈어요. (I took out a small pocket notebook from the bag.)
필통 means pencil case. 문구점에서 예쁜 필통을 골랐어요. (I picked a pretty pencil case at the stationery store.)
본관 means main building. 본관 정문 앞에서 만나요. (Let's meet in front of the main building gate.)

fill.en: I listen to the pronunciation using an electronic dictionary.
I took out a small pocket notebook from the bag.
I received a bouquet at the graduation ceremony.

quiz.why: 전공 means major; specialty. 제 전공 수업은 아주 유익해요. (My major class is very informative.)
나라 means country; nation; state. 어느 나라에서 왔어요? (Which country did you come from?)
러시아 means Russia. 러시아에서 온 유학생을 만났어요. (I met an international student from Russia.)
미국 means United States; America. 삼촌이 지금 미국에 살고 계세요. (My uncle is living in the United States now.)
외국 means foreign country. 외국에서 온 유학생들이 많아요. (There are many international students from foreign countries.)
중국 means China. 중국어 배우기가 참 재미있어요. (Learning Chinese is really fun.)

fill.en: There are embassies of various countries in Seoul.
I am going on a trip to Germany during summer vacation.
I met an international student from Russia.

cards.en: to be thankful; to be grateful (adjective)

quiz.why: 봉사하다 means serve; volunteer. 자원봉사 동아리에서 열심히 봉사했어요. (I actively volunteered in the volunteer club.)
안녕하세요 means hello; hi. 친구에게 안녕하세요 하고 인사해요. (I say hello and greet my friend.)
아니요 means no; no sir; no ma'am. 질문에 아니요라고 고개를 저으며 조용히 대답해요. (I answer no to the question while shaking my head quietly.)
죄송하다 means sorry. 선생님의 질문에 바로 대답하지 못해 정말 죄송해요. (I am really sorry for not being able to answer the teacher's question immediately.)
감사 means gratitude; appreciation; thanks. 선생님께 감사 인사를 올렸어요. (I gave words of gratitude to the teacher.)
안녕 means peace; good health. 헤어질 때 친구에게 안녕 말해요. (When parting, I say goodbye to my friend.)

fill.en: I gave words of gratitude to the teacher.
Pardon me for calling at a late hour.
When parting, I say goodbye to my friend.

quiz.why: 그렇다 means so; as such; like that. 네, 그렇습니다. 제가 바로 그 사람이에요. (Yes, that is so. I am that very person.)
말 means words; speech. 제주도 넓은 초원에서 멋진 말 한 마리가 뛰어가요. (On the wide meadow of Jeju Island, one wonderful horse runs.)
생각하다 means to think. 친구의 입장을 먼저 생각해요. (I think of my friend's position first.)
대화 means conversation; dialogue. 한국어로 간단한 대화가 가능해요. (Simple conversation in Korean is possible.)
소개 means introduction. 수업 시간에 자기 소개를 했어요. (I did a self-introduction during class.)
표현하다 means express; represent; manifest. 자신의 생각을 솔직하게 표현하세요. (Please express your thoughts honestly.)

fill.en: I did a self-introduction during class.
I asked the reason why the appointment was cancelled.
I accidentally dialed the wrong number.

cards.en: to contact; to get in touch (verb)
to be stained; to stick to (verb)

quiz.why: 알려주다 means to inform; to let know. 새로운 연락처를 친구에게 알려주세요. (Please let your friend know your new contact information.)
글쎄요 means well; hm. 글쎄요, 생각해 보고 말씀드릴게요. (Well, let me think about it and tell you.)
유명 means being famous; being popular. 유명한 관광지에 사람이 많아요. (There are many people at famous tourist attractions.)
전화하다 means call; phone. 저녁 식사 후에 가족들에게 안부 전화를 해요. (After dinner, I call my family to check on them.)
연락드리다 means to contact; to get in touch. 도착해서 부모님께 연락드렸어요. (I arrived and contacted my parents.)
전화번호 means phone number. 전화번호가 바뀌어서 알려 드려요. (My phone number has changed, so I let you know.)

fill.en: My phone number has changed, so I let you know.
I received a travel map at the tourist information center.

quiz.why: 질문 means question. 수업이 끝난 후 이해가 안 된 부분에 대해 질문을 해요. (After class ends, I ask questions about parts I did not understand.)
부탁 means request. 선배에게 도움을 부탁했어요. (I asked my senior for help.)
카메라 means camera. 아름다운 풍경을 작은 카메라로 찰칵 찍어요. (I click and take a photo of the beautiful landscape with a small camera.)
공항 means airport. 인천공항에 친구를 마중 나가요. (I go out to Incheon Airport to meet my friend.)
장소 means place; venue. 우리는 모임 장소를 지하철역 앞 카페로 정했어요. (We set the meeting location to a cafe in front of the subway station.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to come out"?

제주도 means Jeju-do Province. 방학을 맞이하여 비행기를 타고 제주도로 여행을 가요. (For the vacation, I take an airplane and travel to Jeju Island.)

택시 means taxi; cab. 길에서 택시를 손을 들어 잡아요. (I raise my hand to catch a taxi on the street.)
아르바이트 means part-time job; side job; student job; moonlighting. 방학 동안 아르바이트를 구해요. (I look for a part-time job during vacation.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "way back from work"?

fill.en: I look for a part-time job during vacation.
Every morning, I take the subway and commute to the company.

새로 means newly; afresh. 새 학기를 맞이하여 새로 한국어 공부 계획을 세웠어요. (Welcoming the new semester, I newly set a Korean study plan.)
짧다 means to be short. 여름에는 시원하고 편한 짧은 바지를 자주 입어요. (In summer, I often wear cool and comfortable short pants.)
줄다 means to decrease; to diminish. 운동을 해서 몸무게가 줄었어요. (I exercised, so my body weight decreased.)
위치 means location; position. 방문 가구 배치를 바꾸기 위해 침대 위치를 옮겨요. (To change the room furniture layout, I move the position of the bed.)
지키다 means to protect; to obey. 친구와 약속한 시간을 철저하게 지켜요. (I strictly keep the time promised with my friend.)

가져가다 means bring. 오후에 비 소식이 있어서 가방에 우산을 챙겨 가져가요. (There is rain in the forecast this afternoon, so I pack and take an umbrella.)
놓다 means to put down; to place. 책상 위에 펜을 놓아요. (I put a pen on the desk.)

하늘 means sky. 푸른 하늘에 흰 구름이 떠 있어요. (White clouds float in the blue sky.)
경치 means scenery; view. 창밖으로 멋진 바다 경치가 보여요. (A wonderful ocean view is seen outside the window.)
땅 means land; ground. 땅 위에 예쁜 꽃씨를 심었어요. (I planted pretty flower seeds in the ground.)

fill.en: The elephant's trunk is very long.

quiz.why: 풍경 means scenery; scene; view; landscape. 창밖 풍경을 바라보아요. (I look at the scenery outside the window.)
피다 means bloom; blossom. 공원에 벚꽃이 활짝 피었어요. (Cherry blossoms bloomed fully in the park.)
자라다 means to grow. 저는 조용한 시골 마을에서 자랐어요. (I grew up in a quiet rural village.)
장미 means rose. 장미 한 송이를 선물해요. (I give a single rose as a gift.)
그분 means that person (honorific). 저기 계신 그분께 한번 물어보세요. (Please ask that person over there.)
아줌마 means middle-aged woman; ajumma. 이웃집 아줌마와 반갑게 인사해요. (I greet the neighborhood lady warmly.)

fill.en: I take care of the garden beautifully.
Two young ladies enter the clothing store.

quiz.why: 남녀 means men and women; both sexes. 남녀 학생들이 함께 모여 토론해요. (Male and female students gather together to discuss.)
부자 means rich person. 부자가 되어 이웃을 돕고 싶어요. (I want to become wealthy and help neighbors.)
스스로 means by oneself; voluntarily. 스스로 결정하고 책임을 져요. (I decide on my own and take responsibility.)
자신 means oneself; confidence. 시험에 자신이 있어요. (I have confidence in the exam.)
관계 means official world; government circles. 두 사람의 관계가 아주 가까워요. (The relationship between the two is very close.)
결혼 means marriage; wedding; union; matrimony. 결혼해서 행복하게 살고 있어요. (I got married and am living happily.)

fill.en: I decide on my own and take responsibility.
I have confidence in the exam.

cards.en: embrace; hug; hold someone in one's arms (verb)

quiz.why: 데려오다 means to bring (someone). 학교에서 동생을 데려올게요. (I will bring my sibling from school.)
선배 means senior. 동아리 선배들과 함께 점심을 먹어요. (I have lunch with seniors from the club.)
식구 means family member; family. 온 식구가 둘러앉아 저녁을 먹어요. (The whole family sits around to eat dinner.)
신혼여행 means honeymoon. 신혼여행에서 찍은 사진이 예뻐요. (Photos taken on the honeymoon are pretty.)
아빠 means dad; daddy. 아빠가 맛있는 간식을 사 오셨어요. (Dad bought and brought delicious snacks.)
애인 means lover; partner. 애인에게 줄 선물을 골랐어요. (I picked a gift to give to my partner.)

fill.en: The whole family sits around to eat dinner.
The groom and bride enter the wedding hall.

quiz.why: 이모 means maternal aunt. 이모가 맛있는 음식을 줘요. (My aunt gives me delicious food.)
형제 means brothers; siblings. 형제끼리 서로 도와요. (Brothers help each other.)
경찰 means police; policing. 길을 잃어서 경찰의 도움을 받았어요. (I got lost and received help from the police.)
교수 means professor. 교수님의 연구실을 찾아갔어요. (I visited the professor's office.)
변호사 means lawyer; attorney. 친절한 변호사의 도움을 받았어요. (I received help from a kind attorney.)
선수 means athlete; player. 국가대표 선수가 되려고 매일 훈련해요. (He trains daily to become a national athlete.)

fill.en: My childhood dream was to be a wonderful artist.
My younger sister is a university hospital nurse.
I got lost and received help from the police.

quiz.why: 늙다 means to grow old; age. 나이가 들어도 마음은 늙지 않아요. (Even as age increases, the heart does not age.)
청년 means young person; youth. 청년들이 모여 토론해요. (Young people gather to debate.)
날씬하다 means slim; slender. 날씬한 핏의 원피스를 입었어요. (I wore a slim-fit dress.)
멋 means stylishness; being fashionable; being chic. 한복은 전통의 멋이 담겨 있어요. (Hanbok embodies the stylish charm of tradition.)
정문 means main gate; front gate. 정문으로 버스가 들어와요. (A bus enters through the main gate.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "high school student"?
quiz.why: 고등학생 means high school student. 고등학생들이 버스에 많이 타요. (Many high school students board the bus.)

fill.en: A bus enters through the main gate.

fill.q: 이번 학기에 ___을 한 번도 안 했어요.
fill.en: I wasn't absent even once this semester.
There is a high school near my house.

quiz.why: 입학 means admission to school; entrance. 입학 축하 선물을 줘요. (I give an admission congratulatory gift.)
지각 means being late; tardiness. 지각하지 않게 서둘러요. (Hurry up so as not to be late.)
출석 means attendance; presence. 모든 수업에 출석했어요. (I attended all classes.)
외우다 means memorize. 시험을 위해 문법을 외웠어요. (I memorized grammar for the exam.)
지우다 means erase. 지우개로 잘못 쓴 글자를 지웠어요. (I erased the misspelled letter with an eraser.)
일기 means diary; journal. 한국어로 짧은 일기를 써요. (I write a short diary entry in Korean.)

fill.en: I attend an elementary school near my house.
Elementary students play on the playground.

quiz.why: 교과서 means textbook. 교과서를 읽으며 열심히 예습해요. (I prepare thoroughly while reading the textbook.)
기억 means memory; remembrance. 그 사람의 전화번호가 기억에 없어요. (That person's phone number is not in my memory.)
문제 means problem; issue. 문제가 생기면 바로 상의하세요. (If a problem arises, consult right away.)
상 means good; top. 저녁 식사를 위해 식탁 상을 차려요. (I set the dining table for dinner.)
예습 means preview; preparation for class. 예습을 열심히 했어요. (I prepared hard for the lesson.)
종이 means paper. 종이 한 장만 주세요. (Please give me a sheet of paper.)

fill.en: I bought a thick spiral notebook at the bookstore.
If a problem arises, consult right away.
I review for an hour every evening.

cards.en: immigration; entry and departure from a country (noun)

quiz.why: 국제 means international. 국제 전화 요금이 많이 나왔어요. (The international phone call bill came out high.)
세상 means world; society. 모두가 행복한 세상을 꿈꿔요. (I dream of a world where everyone is happy.)
안전 means safety; security. 자동차를 탈 때는 안전벨트를 매세요. (Please fasten your seatbelt when riding a car.)
금지 means ban. 건물 안에서는 흡연이 금지예요. (Smoking is prohibited inside the building.)
자기소개 means self-introduction. 한국어로 자기소개를 준비했어요. (I prepared a self-introduction in Korean.)
뵙다 means to see; meet (hon.). 내일 연구실에서 교수님을 뵙겠습니다. (I will meet the professor in the office tomorrow.)

fill.en: All citizens must obey the law well.
I always carry my ID card in my wallet.
Please fasten your seatbelt when riding a car.
immigration; entry and departure from a country

quiz.why: 환영 means welcome. 환영 파티를 열었어요. (We threw a welcome party.)
사실 means fact. 사실 저는 매운 것을 잘 못 먹어요. (Actually, I cannot eat spicy food well.)
아무것 means anything. 점심은 아무것이나 다 좋아요. (Anything is fine for lunch.)
진짜 means authentic. 그 이야기가 진짜예요? (Is that story real?)
알아보다 means investigate; examine; look into. 오랜만에 만난 친구를 알아봤어요. (I recognized my friend who I met after a long time.)
의미 means meaning; sense. 의미가 좋은 노래를 들었어요. (I listened to a song with a nice meaning.)

fill.en: Do not compare yourself with others.

quiz.why: 만약 means supposing. 만약 도움이 필요하면 꼭 연락하세요. (In case you need help, definitely contact me.)
분명하다 means clear; distinct. 이유가 분명하니 안심하세요. (The reason is clear, so rest assured.)
소식 means news; word. 가족에게 자주 소식을 전해 주세요. (Please send news to your family often.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to go poorly"?
quiz.why: 안되다 means to go poorly; pitiful. 친구가 아프다니 참 안됐어요. (It is very unfortunate that my friend is sick.)
옳다 means right; correct; proper. 옳은 판단을 했어요. (You made the right judgment.)
전하다 means convey; give; pass on. 선생님께 편지를 전했어요. (I handed the letter to the teacher.)

fill.en: Please send news to your family often.
Oh no, has the appointment time already arrived?

fill.q: 그 친구는 ___ 지금 집에 있을 거예요.
fill.en: That friend is probably at home now.

quiz.why: 메시지 means message. 메시지를 확인하고 바로 답장해요. (I check the message and reply immediately.)
통화 means phone conversation; call. 지금 통화 괜찮으세요? (Are you okay to talk on the phone now?)
거절 means refusal; rejection; denial. 친구의 제안을 거절하기 미안해요. (I feel sorry to decline my friend's suggestion.)
여쭙다 means ask; inquire (honorific). 한 가지 여쭙고 싶어요. (I would like to ask one thing.)
연결 means connection. 컴퓨터와 모니터를 케이블로 연결해요. (I connect the computer and monitor with a cable.)
전화기 means telephone; phone device. 새 전화기를 샀어요. (I bought a new telephone.)

fill.en: To Teacher, Sincerely yours, Min-soo Kim.
I feel sorry to decline my friend's suggestion.
The delivery courier delivered the parcel.

cards.en: be blocked; be closed; be clogged (verb)

quiz.why: 막히다 means be blocked; be closed; be clogged. 세면대 구멍이 머리카락으로 막혔어요. (The sink hole was clogged with hair.)
광주 means Gwangju. 광주에는 맛있는 음식이 참 많아요. (There is really a lot of delicious food in Gwangju.)
도시 means city. 복잡한 도시를 떠나 여행을 가요. (I leave the crowded city and go traveling.)
빌딩 means building. 회사 빌딩 로비에서 친구를 만나요. (I meet my friend in the lobby of the office building.)
울산 means Ulsan. 기차를 타고 울산에 가요. (I go to Ulsan by train.)
출구 means exit. 지하철 출구를 찾았어요. (I found the subway exit.)

fill.en: Daejeon is a city with very convenient transportation.
I leave the crowded city and go traveling.
Our neighborhood has clean air and is nice to live in.
be blocked; be closed; be clogged

cards.en: to walk here; come on foot (verb)
to go down; to head down (verb)

quiz.why: 지도 means map. 선생님의 따뜻한 지도를 받았어요. (I received warm guidance from the teacher.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to walk here"?
quiz.why: 걸어오다 means to walk here; come on foot. 학교까지 천천히 걸어와요. (I walk slowly all the way to school.)
내려가다 means to go down; to head down. 엘리베이터를 타고 지하로 내려가요. (I take the elevator and go down to the basement.)
돌다 means to turn; to spin. 공원 주변을 한 바퀴 돌았어요. (I turned one round around the park.)
뒤쪽 means back; rear. 버스 뒤쪽 자리로 이동해 주세요. (Please move to the seats at the back of the bus.)
똑바로 means straight; upright. 의자에 허리를 펴고 똑바로 앉아요. (Sit upright on the chair with your back straight.)

fill.en: Please move to the seats at the back of the bus.
Sit upright on the chair with your back straight.
Mountains are seen far away outside the window.

quiz.why: 북쪽 means north. 북쪽 지방은 겨울에 눈이 많이 와요. (The northern region gets a lot of snow in winter.)
삼거리 means three-way intersection. 삼거리에서 오른쪽 길로 가세요. (Please take the right road at the three-way intersection.)
신호 means signal; sign. 빨간 신호에 차를 멈추었어요. (I stopped the car on the red signal.)
육교 means pedestrian overpass; footbridge. 육교 계단을 올라가요. (Climb the steps of the overpass.)
관광 means tourism. 서울 시내 관광을 하루 동안 했어요. (I did sightseeing in downtown Seoul for a day.)
소풍 means trip; picnic; outing. 소풍 갈 때 김밥을 맛있게 싸요. (I pack kimbap deliciously when going on a picnic.)

fill.en: I stopped the car on the red signal.
Cars depart as the traffic light changes.
Climb the steps of the overpass.

quiz.why: 이용 means use; utilization. 도서관 시설을 무료로 이용해요. (I use the library facilities for free.)
운전하다 means drive; operate. 주말에 차를 운전해서 바다에 가요. (I drive a car to the sea on weekends.)
기차역 means train station. 기차역 대합실에서 열차를 기다려요. (I wait for the train in the station waiting room.)
정거장 means station; stop. 다음 정거장에서 내려요. (I get off at the next stop.)
요리사 means cook; chef. 요리사가 되고 싶어요. (I want to become a chef.)
그만두다 means to quit; to stop doing. 건강을 위해 일을 그만두었어요. (I stopped working for my health.)

fill.en: A big car accident occurred on the road.
I wait for the train in the station waiting room.
I meet a friend at the subway station.

cards.en: going to work; arriving at work (noun)

quiz.why: 사업 means business; project. 새 사업을 시작하려고 계획을 세워요. (I make a plan to start a new business.)
직장 means workplace; job. 직장에서 열심히 일해요. (I work hard at my job.)
출퇴근 means commuting (to and from work). 출퇴근 시간에 길이 막혀요. (Traffic is heavy during commute hours.)
위험 means danger; risk. 위험을 미리 피해요. (Avoid danger in advance.)
성공 means success. 새 프로젝트를 성공으로 이끌었어요. (I led the new project to success.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "going to work"?
quiz.why: 출근 means going to work; arriving at work. 출근 시간이 빨라졌어요. (My work arrival time became earlier.)

fill.en: My work arrival time became earlier.
I returned from the business trip.
Traffic is heavy during commute hours.
